incident.description: TEST / DEMO exploit report for the PlutusShield holder claim kit drill on Cardano Preview + Midnight Preprod. No funds were lost and no contract was exploited. The holder seals this bundle into a passphrase-encrypted claim kit (no operator key dir), files it with fileClaim on the v2 registry, two of three committee seats verify it off-ledger and vote, and the Cardano exploit pool pays only on a 2-of-3 committee-signed Settle. The tx hash listed is the policy's own Buy tx, used as a placeholder reference. Incident timestamps are drill placeholders.
